name: moodle-teacher
description: Work in your Moodle courses as their teacher, through moodle-mcp: building them, grading, following the class, checking and reusing courses, with how to do each well in Moodle.

interface.shortDescription: Your AI agent works in the Moodle courses you teach, as you, and knows how to do it well.
interface.longDescription: Work in your Moodle courses as their teacher, through moodle-mcp: building them, grading, following the class, checking and reusing courses, with how to do each well in Moodle.
defaultPrompt: Grade the essays of unit 3 with their rubric, and show me the proposals first.
Make a 10-question quiz on fractions from the course's question bank.
Copy last year's unit 2 from my old school's Moodle into this year's course.
